# ChartBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for all charts that provides common functionality for drawing charts using the ICanvas interface. This ensures charts can be rendered to any backend (PDF, SVG, etc.) without modification.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Properties

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Alternate text description for screen readers.
- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Background color for the chart (default: null/transparent).
- [`Data`](#data): Data rendered by this chart when it is used as a document element.
- [`Height`](#height): Height of the chart canvas in points
- [`IsDecorative`](#isdecorative): Marks the chart as decorative even when alternate text is present.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`.
- [`StretchToFit`](#stretchtofit): When true, the chart will stretch to fill the container width.
- [`SvgShapeRendering`](#svgshaperendering): Preferred root `shape-rendering` for standalone SVG export (`ToSvg`).
- [`Theme`](#theme): Appearance preset: "legacy" (default) or "modern".
- [`Title`](#title): Visible title drawn inside the chart.
- [`Width`](#width): Width of the chart canvas in points

### `BackgroundColor`

```csharp
Color? BackgroundColor { get; set; }
```

Background color for the chart (default: null/transparent). When null, no background is drawn, allowing the chart to blend with document content. Set to Color.White for standalone chart images.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `StretchToFit`

```csharp
bool StretchToFit { get; set; }
```

When true, the chart will stretch to fill the container width. The Width property will be set automatically by the document layout engine.

### `SvgShapeRendering`

```csharp
string SvgShapeRendering { get; set; }
```

Preferred root `shape-rendering` for standalone SVG export (`ToSvg`). `null` (the default) keeps the SVG default antialiasing, which is required for charts with diagonal lines, arcs, or circles. Axis-aligned charts (bar, grouped bar) set this to `"crispEdges"` so their bars and gridlines snap to the pixel grid instead of softening into blurred edges. Text is governed by `text-rendering`, so it is unaffected.
